scope: Explicit QUALITY_PRECONDITION failures before product evidence begins
issues.rationale: This is a permanent attribution boundary, not a waiver: permission, session, device, or fixture preparation must stop before payload injection and cannot become product green.
issues.exit_criteria: Keep the category while App-owned preparation exists; fix each concrete precondition failure at its source and never retry it as a product assertion.

scope: AndroidX Compose device-test drawing runtime after individual product journeys may already have completed
issues.rationale: The aggregate run is NOT RUN/FAILED_TEST_SYSTEM only when every current XML failure has this exact runtime signature; mixed product assertions remain product FAILED.
issues.exit_criteria: Remove the classification after 50 consecutive controlled-emulator device classes without the signature or after upgrading to a verified AndroidX Compose runtime that eliminates it.
issues.resolution: Existing 50-class exit criterion met on frozen d347472: 13 rounds / 52 consecutive controlled API35 x86_64 device classes / 442 native methods, zero failures, errors, skips, registered signatures or App crashes, no retries. This retires the classification; it does not assert an upstream cause or physical-device acceptance.
